title.en: Educational Policies and Plans of Pakistan (EFMP-303)
title.ur: پاکستان کی تعلیمی پالیسیاں اور منصوبے (EFMP-303)

visual_style: Vertical 9:16, warm natural daylight, gentle realistic cinematic look. A Pakistani government school: whitewashed walls, a plain green blackboard with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame. Nobody speaks to the camera; the narration is a voice-over.

narrator.name: off-screen narrator
narrator.description: An unseen Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties, warm, clear and confident; voice-over only, never shown on camera.

shots.visual: Slow push-in on an overcrowded Pakistani government classroom with a few broken desks, pupils sharing benches, light from a single window.
A long wooden table in a modest education office: officials with closed folders and tea cups listen as one speaks; papers blurred and unreadable.
A head teacher walks through a school courtyard with a clipboard, observing classes through open doorways; writing on the clipboard unreadable.
A newly repaired classroom with fresh paint and new desks; pupils enter and sit down smiling as a teacher welcomes them.

In a sunlit school corridor, a young woman trainee teacher holds a phone and scrolls a textbook page (screen blurred, unreadable), then looks up with a confident smile as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: ہر حکومت نئی تعلیمی پالیسی لاتی ہے۔ پھر بھی ہمارے اسکول ویسے کیوں ہیں؟
اس کورس میں آپ پاکستان کی تعلیمی پالیسیوں کی تاریخ اور national development plans پڑھیں گے۔
آپ national اور provincial سطح پر educational planning، monitoring اور evaluation، اور implementation کے challenges سمجھیں گے۔
چھ units، quality assurance سے international perspectives تک، تاکہ آپ بہتر منصوبہ بندی کی تجاویز دے سکیں۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔

end_card.headline: پاکستان کی تعلیمی پالیسیاں اور منصوبے (EFMP-303)
